resource.description: SWIFT-linked bank census slice: every bank named in a dated public notice about the Swift digital-asset MVP. Each row keeps its notice's own wording (LIVE, COMMITTED, DISCOVERED) and a hashed press URL; mixed identity by design, never a client list. States: INDEXED, UNCHECKABLE or UNMEASURED, with n and as_of read at request time. Free preview; verification is free.

csoai.pricing_terms: accepts[] carries a launch amount until 2027-01-11T00:00:00Z (end of 2027-01-10 UTC). From then this request asks its standard amount, the one in csoai_pricing.normal_amount_atomic. Read accepts[] on every call; your wallet signs exactly the amount shown and nothing more.

offer_receipt.verify: base64url-decode the JWS payload part, fetch https://csoai.org/.well-known/did.json, take the publicKeyJwk.x of the verificationMethod whose id equals the header kid, and verify Ed25519 over `header.payload`. POST the compact string to /api/receipts/verify to have us do it, or run the same-site https://councilof.ai/verifier/verify_receipt.py checker. Default mode reads the public DID document; saved-key replay can be offline. Signature validity is not proof of settlement.
